answer: Continuous Attestation Ledger. Each identity must submit a daily "atlas" of micro-tasks (labeling, routing, verification) that only sustained human-like attention can complete accurately. A "summit" review board samples submissions; errors accumulate as reputation debt that throttles task allocation. To sustain many identities, an attacker must spend real hours per day per account, so marginal accounts lose money at a "sparrow" rate—small per task but continuous, making mass farming uneconomic while honest single operators profit.
